pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā upaṭṭhākakulaṃ thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.6: tena kho pana samayena tassa kulassa gharaṃ dayhati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā amhākaṃ deyyadhammaṃ antarāyaṃ karissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.9: ubhayenamha paribāhirā bhogehi ca puññena cāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.10: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.11: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā gaṇassa cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ karissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.13: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī gaṇassa cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ karotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.16: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī gaṇassa cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ karissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:1.19.1: yā pana bhikkhunī gaṇassa cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ kareyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:2.1.8: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanupagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:2.1.10: kathaṃ imaṃ cīvaraṃ dadeyyunti antarāyaṃ karoti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:2.1.11: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ antarāyaṃ karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc26:2.1.12: sambahulānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā anupasampannāya vā cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ antarāyaṃ karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
